description: This Java source file defines the class 'FDistribution', which implements the F-distribution in the Apache Commons Math library. It includes methods for calculating density, cumulative probability, mean, variance, and provides constructors to create distribution instances with specific degrees of freedom.

classes.name: FDistribution
classes.description: Implementation of the F-distribution with methods to compute density, cumulative probability, mean, variance, and support bounds. It extends AbstractRealDistribution and provides multiple constructors for flexibility in instantiation.

methods.name: density
methods.description: Calculates the probability density function (PDF) at a given point x.

methods.name: logDensity
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of the density at a given point x.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Computes the cumulative distribution function (CDF) at a given value x.

methods.name: getNumeratorDegreesOfFreedom
methods.description: Returns the numerator degrees of freedom parameter.

methods.name: getDenominatorDegreesOfFreedom
methods.description: Returns the denominator degrees of freedom parameter.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution if defined; otherwise NaN.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns the variance of the distribution if defined; otherwise NaN. Uses cached calculation.

methods.name: calculateNumericalVariance
methods.description: Performs the calculation of the variance based on degrees of freedom.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the support (always 0).

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the support (positive infinity).

methods.name: isSupportLowerBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates whether the support lower bound is inclusive (always false).

methods.name: isSupportUpperBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates whether the support upper bound is inclusive (always false).

methods.name: isSupportConnected
methods.description: Indicates whether the support is connected (always true).
